data.gender_notes: Kaheela is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'Kahilah' meaning 'sublime' or 'exalted'. In Islamic tradition, Kaheela symbolizes spiritual elevation, wisdom, and divine favor. The name Kaheela carries the meaning “The Sublime, The Exalted” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Kaheela usually hope their child will grow to embody the sublime, the exalted and live with faith, good character and purpose.
